recent_posts.title: eBay Partners with Meta for New Affiliate Program, Boosting Social Commerce for Sellers and Creators
recent_posts.summary: eBay has announced a beta partnership with Meta to join Facebook's affiliate partnerships program. This integration allows Facebook creators to embed eBay listings directly into their content (Reels, photos, text posts). When followers purchase through these links, creators earn commissions. The program aims to expand eBay seller reach through creator-led storytelling while giving creators a new monetization stream. The beta is set to launch in the coming months.

recent_posts.title: eBay executives predict AI trends for commerce in 2026
recent_posts.summary: eBay executives share predictions for AI's impact on commerce in 2026. Key themes include trust becoming the primary currency through continuous AI-powered verification, AI enabling sustainable circular commerce through better product discovery and recycling, context-aware AI unlocking developer productivity in large organizations, and AI creating more emotionally engaging shopping experiences. The focus shifts from automation to human-centric experiences with zero-friction transactions.

recent_posts.title: eBay deploys AI tools for sellers and buyers during holiday season
recent_posts.summary: eBay has deployed AI-powered tools to streamline holiday shopping and selling. Sellers benefit from simplified listing creation using generative AI (500K+ daily listings), automated background enhancement, and an AI messaging assistant for handling buyer inquiries. Over 10 million sellers have adopted these features. For buyers, eBay offers personalized discovery through AI shopping assistants, LLM-powered fashion recommendations, and integration with platforms like ChatGPT. The marketplace also uses AI for authentication and verification through Authenticity Guarantee and Certilogo technology to ensure trust and safety in transactions.

recent_posts.title: eBay Honored at Fast Company's Innovation by Design Awards
recent_posts.summary: eBay received three honorable mentions at Fast Company's Innovation by Design Awards 2025 for their eBay Evo unified brand and design system. The recognition spans UX Design, Enduring Impact, and Large Business categories. eBay Evo, launched in 2024, was developed in-house to enhance consistency and usability across the platform, accompanied by a comprehensive 280-page eBay Playbook with over 2,700 images and interactive design tools.

recent_posts.title: Introducing a New Way to Use Generative AI for Social Selling
recent_posts.summary: eBay has launched a generative AI video tool that allows sellers to transform listing images into short form videos for social media. The tool simplifies video creation with customizable options, making it easy to share on platforms like YouTube and TikTok without requiring video editing skills. Initially available for US sellers, eBay plans to expand its capabilities for broader reach to boost brand visibility and engagement.

recent_posts.title: eBay Uses Agentic AI to Supercharge Personalized Ecommerce
recent_posts.summary: eBay is launching a new AI shopping agent to enhance personalized eCommerce experiences. The intelligent agent offers real-time, tailored product recommendations and expert guidance based on users' shopping preferences. This development is part of eBay's strategy to lead AI-powered eCommerce using its extensive infrastructure and customer insights. The AI features are developed with eBay's Responsible AI team to ensure safety, fairness, and accountability, and the new shopping experience is gradually being rolled out to U.S. customers.

recent_posts.title: eBay launches AI-powered mobile listing tool
recent_posts.summary: eBay has introduced a new, streamlined mobile selling tool that integrates AI technology to simplify and speed up the listing process for sellers in the U.S., U.K., and Germany. The tool uses product images and titles to suggest item details and categories, reducing steps and improving listing accuracy. Early tests show a 50% reduction in listing steps and faster listing times. Additional AI-powered tools include bulk listing and background enhancement tools that further aid sellers in optimizing their listings and campaigns.

recent_posts.title: Faster and Local Shopping on eBay Just Got Simpler
recent_posts.summary: eBay has introduced new features to enhance the shopping experience, including fast shipping filters, accurate delivery estimates on item cards, and the eBay Top-Service badge in Germany for identifying top retail standards. These updates leverage AI to ensure precision and simplify the purchasing process.

recent_posts.title: Meet the Winners of the 6th eBay University Machine Learning Challenge
recent_posts.summary: eBay has announced the winners of its 6th University Machine Learning Challenge, where students developed ML solutions for real ecommerce problems. This year's challenge focused on creating models to help shoppers identify vehicle parts and accessories that fit their specific needs. Winners, who will receive a 2025 summer internship at eBay, showcased their work among 530 participants from 121 U.S. universities. Participants gain valuable hands-on experience and eBay recruits new engineering talent. Registration for the next challenge opens later this spring via EvalAI.

recent_posts.title: Announcing a New Collaboration Between eBay and OpenAI
recent_posts.summary: eBay has announced a collaboration with OpenAI to integrate AI agent technology named Operator into its ecommerce platform. This partnership aims to enhance the online shopping experience by leveraging autonomous AI systems that assist with tasks like discovering unique inventory on eBay. The collaboration is part of eBay’s broader AI strategy to empower buyers and sellers in the digital economy.
